title: BEQDesigner .signal file
description: Written by File > Save Signal and read by File > Load Signal. Stored as gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSON; decompress to get the JSON described here. A single signal (or bass-managed group of channels). Produced by model.codec.signaldata_to_json / bassmanagedsignaldata_to_json and read back by model.codec.signaldata_from_json in src/main/python/model/codec.py.
